set_dispatch.text: Select one slot for info and options
Press 'SAVE SLOT x' to save the mission with the selected name!
Saving is disabled once ground/hoist operations have started. Save before starting operations, or after they complete.
This save may hold different settings than your active livery enforces (crew count, ground-ops engine requirement, hospital paperwork, rescue track ID). Choose which settings to use for this flight.
